results.question: 哪个品类的退款率最高？
results.sql:
SELECT 
    dp.category,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(fr.refund_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(foi.item_paid_amount), 0), 0) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS refund_rate_pct
FROM fact_orders fo
JOIN fact_order_items foi ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id
LEFT JOIN fact_refunds fr ON foi.order_item_id = fr.order_item_id
WHERE fo.order_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY refund_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: 哪个品类销售额最高？
results.sql:
SELECT
    dp.category,
    SUM(COALESCE(foi.item_paid_amount, 0)) AS item_sales_amount
FROM fact_order_items foi
JOIN fact_orders fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
JOIN dim_product dp ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE fo.order_status = 'paid'
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY item_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
